authored_by: Claude (triage trial session), before any method ran
purpose: Trial of an ultimate-claims settlement forecast (triage row 13) against paid-to-date and chain-ladder completion factors.
truth: Net payer paid by the end of the data (2030-05-27), at least 11 months after each valuation date.
scoring: Signed and absolute percentage error of the six most recent incurred months taken together, per valuation date; mean absolute error across the six.
